issue.body:
We have been re-attempting the designing of Bricks, which serve as the visual counterparts for atomic programming constructs. They are a WIP, and the these are how they currently look.
For a consistent look, here are the following requirements: - The left notch, main label, first row parameter label, and first row right notch should be centered along the same horizontal axis. - Parameter labels should always centrally align with their argument notch counterparts irrespective of the height of the parameter; also the argument notches are always at a first position from the top for that row. - If there is only one parameter (or zero), the axis mentioned above, should be along the center of the Brick like: - There is a minimum y-axis padding needed to account for the top notch inset. - There's support for scale levels: 1, 2, 3. Default is 2. The expected minimum heights of the Bricks are the different scale levels are: - 1: 24px - 2: 32px - 3: 40px - We're going to require support for some interactive widgets, beyond just a label; we need to account for the fact that some of these can't get any shorter than a certain height, and we would still want them centrally aligned along the horizontal axis.
- For Bricks that only take input widgets, as shown above this, it might be better to minimize the paddings and maximize the available height for the widgets, since they wouldn't have inset notches; note that it is still subject to the minimum height requirement so that a Brick with a label (zero/one parameter) and a Brick with a select widget when placed side by side look aligned. There's a ticket #628 to address this issue. - Using same background for the interactive widgets might not be the best look — would be nice to try out some variations. Based on these requirements, brainstorm design modifications. The associated files are located at `modules/masonry/brick`. Only consider the following files, ignore the rest: - `path2.ts` - `Path.tsx` and `Path.stories.tsx` - `Brick.tsx` and `Brick.stories.tsx` - `BrickViewFixed.tsx` and `BrickViewFixed.stories.tsx` - `BrickViewInput.tsx` and `BrickViewInput.stories.tsx` **At this point, this ticket is in discussion/planning phase. Don't push changes until tasks are confirmed.**
